central_topic: Post-draft citation gaps for a study of how grokking delay on modular addition depends on transformer width: width-aware (muP-style) parametrization and Adam effective step size, prior empirical grokking work on weight decay, training fraction and initialization scale, and statistical methodology for the seed-cluster bootstrap and right-censored delays.
core_methods: cluster (seed-level) percentile bootstrap with few clusters
right-censored outcome regression (Tobit / accelerated failure time) versus imputing the cap
comparators: prior empirical grokking studies varying weight decay, training fraction, or initialization scale
architectural_shifts: width-dependent multipliers on hidden and output layers (muP-like parametrization) to equalize effective step size under Adam
result_driven_themes: width slope on log-delay not distinguishable from zero with 40% of runs censored, so censoring handling and parametrization-induced effective-step-size confounds need methodological support

queries.rationale: Gap related-work-parametrization (high): the width-dependent multipliers on hidden and output layers are the muP construction, which the Related Work paragraph on parametrization currently does not cite.

queries.rationale: Gap related-work-parametrization (high): supports the Discussion claim that width-dependent multipliers equalize effective step size under Adam and could mask or create a width slope.

queries.rationale: Gap intro-related-width-dependence-prior-work (high): positions the paper against earlier empirical grokking studies that varied weight decay and training fraction, needed for the Relation to this work paragraph and the capacity-based reading. Phrased around weight decay and data fraction rather than width or model size to follow the forbidden-pattern constraint.

queries.rationale: Gap intro-related-width-dependence-prior-work (high): covers initialization-scale and effective-learning-rate dependence of grokking onset, directly relevant to the init-scale and reparametrization confound.

queries.query: cluster bootstrap inference with few clusters percentile confidence intervals
queries.rationale: Gap method-statistics-cluster-bootstrap-censoring (medium): supports the seed-cluster percentile bootstrap used as the test statistic, including its small-cluster behavior.

queries.rationale: Gap method-statistics-cluster-bootstrap-censoring (medium): supports both the critique of entering censored delays at the cap and the Discussion recommendation to analyze delays as censored data.
